item.title: Volunteers blindsided as I‑35 project threatens newly planted Austin food forest
item.description: A temporary wastewater line tied to the I‑35 Capital Express Central project will cut through the recently expanded Festival Beach Food Forest, according to volunteers who say they were caught off guard by a January 6 email from TxDOT.

item.title: ICE calls APD for assistance after crash in North Loop
item.description: The Austin Police Department said it assisted a crash that involved Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in the North Loop neighborhood Monday.

item.title: Tesla enthusiast takes 57 rides before finding fully autonomous Robotaxi
item.description: Tesla's autonomous vehicle, Robotaxi, has completed some of its first fully unsupervised rides in Austin, Texas. A self-proclaimed AV enthusiast, David Moss, documented his experience on social media. Tesla CEO, Elon Musk, stated that the company has been testing their Robotaxis without a safety monitor in Austin and that the amount of autonomy and city's set to see Robotaxis will increase dramatically every month.

item.title: Texas softball to appear on ESPN networks 14 times in regular season
item.description: The defending national champs will appear on ESPN's cable networks 14 times in the regular season, including two entire series.

item.title: Northbound I-35 exits close for Lady Bird Lake bridge reconstruction
item.description: Expect delays: Key I‑35 ramp closures start Feb. 1 for upcoming Lady Bird Lake bridge construction and early light rail work.

item.title: Our next cold front arrives Tuesday
item.description: Before the front arrives, temperatures should end up reasonably warm with 70s for much of the area. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: 'Just Trying to Delay': Lawyers react to paused naturalization ceremonies in Austin
item.description: Immigration lawyers say the decision by U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services to cancel all naturalization ceremonies in Austin could create a mass of lawsuits if immigrants don't get their ceremony in the timeframe required by law, and is an attempt to keep naturalization numbers down in the country.

item.title: UIL realignment shakes up Austin-area football districts
item.description: Perhaps the biggest change, as far as football is concerned, is the district placement for Lake Travis and Westlake. The powerhouse programs are now out of an Austin-based district and will compete against five Round Rock high schools in District 25-6A. That's a 7-team district with Round Rock, McNeil, Stony Point, Westwood and Cedar Ridge. The Chaparrals and Cavaliers were in a 9-team district during the last 2-year time block.

item.title: Fight breaks out at student-led protest on RM 967 in Buda
item.description: Buda Police said it was notified that students from Moe and Gene Johnson High School were holding a protest at RM 967.

item.title: Texas attorney general investigating Austin ISD policies after anti-ICE student walkouts
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton said on Monday he is demanding that Austin Independent School District provide its policies related to allowing students to leave campus after district officials let students leave school to attend an anti-ICE protest.
